description: Defines classes, functions, and enums related to HTTP alternative services, including handling of protocols, host/port info, and QUIC support within the Chromium project.

classes.name: AlternativeService
classes.description: Represents an alternative network service with protocol, host, and port.

classes.name: AlternativeServiceInfo
classes.description: Holds detailed info about an alternative service, including expiration and supported QUIC versions.

methods.name: HistogramAlternateProtocolUsage
methods.description: Logs usage histogram for alternate protocol usage.

methods.name: HistogramBrokenAlternateProtocolLocation
methods.description: Logs histogram for locations where broken alternate protocols are detected.

methods.name: IsAlternateProtocolValid
methods.description: Checks if a protocol is valid for alternate services.

methods.name: IsProtocolEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a protocol is enabled based on HTTP/2 and QUIC settings.

methods.name: CreateHttp2AlternativeServiceInfo
methods.description: Creates an AlternativeServiceInfo instance for HTTP/2.

methods.name: CreateQuicAlternativeServiceInfo
methods.description: Creates an AlternativeServiceInfo instance for QUIC, with variations for platform.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of AlternativeService and AlternativeServiceInfo.
